translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
Alif-Laam-Raa . yeh ( Allah ki ) kitab aur roshan Quran ki aayaten hain .
aik waqt aaye ga jab yeh kafir log bari tamannayen keren gay kay kaash woh musalman hotay .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) enhen inn ki halat per chorr do kay yeh khoob kha len , mazay urra len , aur khayali umeeden enhen ghaflat mein daalay rakhen ,   kiyonkay unqareeb enhen pata chal jaye ga ( kay haqeeqat kiya thi ) .
aur hum ney jiss kissi basti ko halak kiya tha , uss kay liye aik moyyan waqt likha huwa tha .
koi qoam apney moyyan waqt say naa pehlay halak hoti hai , aur naa uss say aagay jasakti hai .
aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  aey woh shaks jiss per yeh ziker ( yani Quran ) utaara gaya hai ! tum yaqeeni tor per majnoon ho .
agar tum waqaee sachay ho to humaray paas farishton ko kiyon nahi ley aatay-?
hum farishton ko utaartay hain to bar-haq faisla dey ker utaartay hain , aur aisa hota to unn ko mohlat bhi naa milti .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh ziker ( yani Quran ) hum ney hi utaara hai , aur hum hi iss ki hifazat kernay walay hain .
aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tum say pehlay bhi pichli qoamon kay mukhtalif girohon mein apney payghumber bhej chukay hain .
aur unn kay paas koi Rasool aisa nahi aata tha jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay hon .
mujrim logon  kay dilon mein yeh baat   hum issi tarah dakhil kertay hain
kay who uss per emaan nahi latay . aur pichlay logon  ka bhi yehi tareeqa chala aaya hai .
aur agar ( bil-farz ) hum unn kay liye aasman ka koi darwaza khol den , aur woh din ki roshni mein uss per charrhtay bhi chalay jayen ,
tab bhi yehi kahen gay kay humari nazar bandi kerdi gaee hai , balkay hum log jadoo kay asar mein aaye huye hain .
aur hum ney aasman mein boht say burj banaye hain ,   aur uss ko dekhney walon kay liye sajawat ata ki hai ,
aur ussay her mardood shetan say mehfooz rakha hai ,
albatta jo koi chori say kuch sunney ki koshish keray to aik roshan shola uss ka peecha kerta hai .
aur zameen ko hum ney phela diya hai , aur uss ko jamaney kay liye uss mein pahar rakh diye hain ,   aur uss mein her qisam ki cheezen tawazun kay sath ugai hain .
aur uss mein tumharay liye bhi rozi kay saman peda kiye hain , aur unn ( makhlooqaat ) kay liye bhi jinhen tum rizq nahi detay .
aur koi ( zaroorat ki ) cheez aesi nahi hai jiss kay humaray paas khazaney mojood naa hon , magar hum uss ko aik moyyan miqdaar mein utaartay hain .

aur woh hawayen jo badalon ko paani say bhar deti hain , hum ney bheji hain , phir aasman say paani hum ney utaara hai , phir iss/uss say tumhen sairaab hum ney kiya hai , aur tumharay bus mein yeh nahi hai kay tum iss/uss ko zakheera ker kay rakh sako .
hum hi zindagi detay hain , aur hum hi moat detay hain , aur hum hi sabb kay waris hain .
tum mein say jo aagay nikal gaye hain , unn ko bhi hum jantay hain , aur jo peechay reh gaye hain , unn say bhi hum waqif hain .
aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar hi hai jo inn/unn sabb ko hashar mein ikattha keray ga , beyshak uss ki hikmat bhi bari hai , uss ka ilm bhi bara .
hum ney insan ko sarray huye garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say peda kiya ,
aur jinnaat ko iss say pehlay hum ney lo ki aag say peda kiya tha .
aur woh waqt yaad kero jab tumharay perwerdigar ney farishton say kaha tha kay :  mein garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say aik bashar ko peda kernay wala hun .
lehaza jab mein uss ko poori tarah bana lun , aur uss mein apni rooh phoonk dun to tum sabb uss kay aagay sajday mein gir jana .
chunacheh saray kay saray farishton ney sajda kiya ,
siwaye iblees kay kay uss ney sajda kernay walon mein shamil honey say inkar kerdiya .
Allah ney kaha :  iblees ! tujhay kiya huwa kay tu sajda kernay walon mein shamil nahi huwa-?
uss ney kaha :  mein aisa ( gira huwa ) nahi hun kay aik aesay bashar ko sajda kerun jissay tu ney sarray huye garay ki khankhanati hoi mitti say peda kiya hai .
Allah ney kaha :  acha to yahan say nikal jaa , kiyonkay tu mardood hogaya hai ,
aur tujh per qayamat kay din tak phitkaar parri rahey gi .
kehney laga :  ya rab ! phir mujhay uss din tak ( zinda rehney ki ) mohlat deydey jab log marney kay baad dobara zinda kiye jayen gay .
Allah ney farmaya kay :  jaa phir tujhay mohlat ( to ) dey di gaee .
. ( magar ) aik aesi miyaad kay din tak jo hamen maloom hai .

kehney laga :  ya rab ! chunkay tu ney mujhay gumrah kiya hai , iss liye abb mein qasam khata hun kay inn insanon kay liye duniya mein dilkashi peda kerun ga ,   aur inn sabb ko gumrah ker kay rahun ga ,
siwaye teray unn bandon kay jinhen tu ney unn mein say apney liye mukhlis bana liya ho .
Allah ney farmaya :  yeh hai woh seedha raasta jo mujh tak phonchta hai .
yaqeen rakh kay jo meray banday hain , unn per tera koi zor nahi chalay ga ,   siwaye unn gumrah logon  kay jo teray peechay chalen gay
aur jahannum aesay tamam logon  ka tey shuda thikana hai .
uss kay saat darwazay hain . her darwazay ( mein dakhlay ) kay liye unn ( dozakhiyon ka ) aik aik giroh baant diya gaya hai .
. ( doosri taraf ) muttaqi log baaghaat aur chashmon kay darmiyan rahen gay .
. ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay )  inn ( baaghaat ) mein salamti kay sath bey khof ho ker dakhil hojao .
unn kay seenon mein jo kuch ranjish hogi , ussay hum nikal phenken gay ,   woh bhai bhai ban ker aamney samney oonchi nishiston per bethay hon gay .
wahan naa koi thakan unn kay paas aaye gi , aur naa unn ko wahan say nikala jaye ga .
meray bandon ko bata do kay mein hi boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hun .
aur yeh bhi bata do kay mera azab hi dardnak azab hai .
aur enhen Ibrahim kay mehmano ka haal suna do ,
uss waqt ka haal jab woh unn kay paas phonchay , aur salam kiya . Ibrahim ney kaha kay :  hamen to tum say darr lagg raha hai .
unhon ney kaha :  dariye nahi , hum to aap ko aik sahab ilm-e-larkay ( ki wiladat ) ki khushkhabri dey rahey hain .
Ibrahim ney kaha :  kiya tum mujhay iss halat mein khushkhabri dey rahey ho jabkay mujh per burhapa chah chuka hai ? phir kiss buniyad per mujhay khushkhabri dey rahey ho-?
woh bolay :  hum ney aap ko sachi khushkhabri di hai , lehaza aap unn logon  mein shamil naa hon jo naa umeed hojatay hain .
Ibrahim ney kaha :  apney perwerdigar ki rehmat say gumrahon kay siwa kon na-umeed hosakta hai ?
. ( phir ) unhon ney poocha kay :  Allah kay bhejay huye farishto ! abb aap kay samney kiya mohim hai ?
unhon ney kaha :  hamen aik mujrim qoam ki taraf ( azab nazil kernay kay liye ) bheja gaya hai ,
albatta loot kay ghar walay uss say mustasna hain , unn sabb ko hum bachlen gay ,
siwaye unn ki biwi kay . hum ney yeh tey ker rakha hai kay woh unn logon  mein shamil rahey gi jo ( azab ka nishana banney kay liye ) peechay reh jayen gay .
chunacheh jab yeh farishtay loot kay ghar walon kay paas phonchay .
to loot ney kaha :  aap log ajnabi maloom hotay hain .
unhon ney kaha :  nahi , balkay hum aap kay paas woh ( azab ) ley ker aaye hain jiss mein yeh log shak kiya kertay thay .
hum aap kay paas atal faisla ley ker aaye hain , aur yaqeen rakhiye kay hum sachay hain .

lehaza aap raat kay kissi hissay mein apney ghar walon ko ley ker nikal jaiye , aur aap khud unn kay peechay peechay chaliye ,   aur aap mein say koi peechay murr ker naa dekhay , aur wahin janey kay liye chaltay rahen jahan ka aap ko hukum diya jaraha hai .
aur ( iss tarah ) hum ney loot tak apna yeh faisla phoncha diya kay subha hotay hi inn logon  ki jarr kaat ker rakh di jaye gi .
aur shehar walay khushi manatay huye ( loot kay paas ) aa-phonchay .
loot ney ( unn say ) kaha kay :  yeh log meray mehman hain , lehaza mujhay ruswa naa kero ,
aur Allah say daro , aur mujhay zaleel naa kero .
kehney lagay :  kiya hum ney aap ko pehlay hi duniya jahan kay logon  ( ko mehman bananey ) say mana nahi ker rakha tha-?
loot ney kaha :  agar tum meray kehney per amal kero to yeh meri betiyan ( jo tumharay nikah mein hain , tumharay paas ) mojood hi hain .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhari zindagi ki qasam ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh log apni bad-masti mein andhay banay huye thay .
chunacheh sooraj nikaltay hi unn ko chinghaarr ney aa-pakra ,
phir hum ney uss zameen ko tah o baala ker kay rakh diya , aur unn per pakki mitti kay pathron ki barish barsa di .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss saray waqaey mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ibrat ki nigah say dekhtay hon .
aur yeh bastiyan aik aesay raastay per waqay hain jiss per log mustaqil chaltay rehtay hain .
yaqeenan iss mein emaan walon kay liye bari ibrat hai .
aur aieka kay bashinday ( bhi ) baray zalim thay .
chunacheh hum ney unn say bhi intiqam liya . aur unn dono qoamon ki bastiyan khuli shahraah per waqay hain .
aur hajar kay bashindon ney bhi payghumberon ko jhutlaya tha .
aur hum ney unn ko apni nishaniyan den to woh unn say mun morray rahey .
aur woh paharon ko tarash tarash ker bey khof o khatar makan banaya kertay thay .
aakhir unhen subha subha aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra .
aur nateeja yeh huwa kay jiss hunar say woh kamai kertay thay , woh unn kay kuch kaam naa aaya .

aur hum ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan jo kuch hai uss ko kissi bar-haq maqsad kay baghair peda nahi kiya .   aur qayamat ki gharri aa-ker rahey gi . lehaza ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron kay tarz-e-amal per ) khoobsurti kay sath darguzar say kaam lo .
yaqeen rakho kay tumhara rab hi sabb ko peda kernay wala , sabb kuch janney wala hai .
aur hum ney tumhen saat aesi aayaten dey rakhi hain jo baar baar parhi jati hain ,   aur azmat wala Quran ata kiya hai .

aur tum unn cheezon ki taraf hergiz aankh utha ker bhi naa dekho jo hum ney inn ( kafiron ) mein say mukhtalif logon  ko mazay uraney kay liye dey rakhi hain , aur naa inn logon  per apna dil kurrhao , aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , unn kay liye apni shafqat ka bazoo phela do .
aur ( kufr kernay walon say ) keh do kay mein to bus khulay alfaz mein tanbeeh kernay wala hun .
. ( yeh tanbeeh Quran-e-azeem kay zariye ussi tarah nazil ki gaee hai ) jaisay hum ney unn tafarqa kernay walon per nazil ki thi .
jinhon ney ( apni ) parhi janey wali kitab kay hissay bakhray kerliye thay .
chunacheh tumharay rab ki qasam ! hum aik aik ker kay unn sabb say poochen gay .
kay woh kiya kuch kiya kertay thay .
lehaza jiss baat ka tumhen hukum diya jaraha hai , ussay al-al-aelaan logon  ko suna do ,   aur jo log ( phir bhi ) shirk keren , unn ki perwa matt kero .
yaqeen rakho kay hum tumhari taraf say unn logon  say nimatney kay liye kafi hain jo ( tumhara ) mazaq uratay hain ,
jinhon ney Allah kay sath koi aur mabood gharr rakha hai . chunacheh unqareeb unhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .
yaqeenan hum jantay hain kay jo baaten yeh banatay hain , unn say tumhara dil tang hota hai .
to ( iss ka ilaj yeh hai kay ) tum apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay raho , aur sajda baja laney walon mein shamil raho .
aur apney perwerdigar ki ibadat kertay raho , yahan tak kay tum per woh cheez aajaye jiss ka aana yaqeeni hai .
